instruction: Access the Add-ons Manager in Thunderbird to manage extensions and themes.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the Add-ons Manager in Thunderbird. This can be accessed via Tools > Add-ons and Themes or hamburger menu > Add-ons. Evaluator uses check_accessibility_tree to verify the 'Add-ons Manager' tab is present in the tab list. Similar difficulty to original task - simple navigation to a management interface.
metadata.verification: The evaluator checks for the presence of a page-tab named 'Add-ons Manager' in the Thunderbird tab list using accessibility tree selectors. This matches the expected behavior when Add-ons Manager is opened.
